study: mcp-probe conformance & reliability — v1 run (expanded frame)
notes: v1 run: frame expanded from the 9-server v0 pilot to 24 candidates (16 included). Schema validity held at 100% and the annotation gap stayed a clean all-or-nothing server-level split as n nearly doubled.
Absolute percentages will keep shifting as the frame grows; the method and deviation categories are the reusable contribution.
Round-trip tool calls disabled for the ecosystem sweep (no side-effecting tools invoked); only the 'everything' reference test server is round-trip-safe.
Handshake latency includes first-run npx install cost and is not a clean latency measurement (see STUDY.md threats-to-validity).
Reference-set packages should be pinned to a commit SHA before a citable release; this pilot used the latest npm-published versions on the run date (recorded per-server in summary.csv).
